newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields steady, awaiting U.S. PPI.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields steady, awaiting U.S. PPI.

text.p: Yields were flat and the crown firmer in quiet trade ahead of U.S. PPI data.
"The crown may weaken somewhat if people take profits," one dealer said. He said the crown would be traded between 4.4950 and 4.5150 against the mark during the remainder of the day.
Yields were flat but off this morning's lows.
"We might have seen some profit-taking just now but the firmer crown could support a fall in yields," one analyst said.
The market is eyeing U.S. PPI due at 1230 GMT in the wake of Thursday's weak retail sales data which will give further clues about the possibility of a U.S. rate hike in July.
Six month T-bill rate was one basis point higher at 4.18 and the ten year bond yield was flat at 6.83 percent. The crown firmed to 4.4945 against the mark versus 4.5040 on Thursday.
